records.title: European Social Survey
records.scope: Cross-national repeated surveys. Inspect round-specific religion, wellbeing and health variables before analysis.
records.access: Official ESS data portal. Round-specific terms and documentation govern use.

records.title: European Values Study
records.scope: Values, religion, family, work, politics and society. Not every wave contains a mental-health outcome suitable for a MARSAM question.
records.access: EVS/GESIS documentation and data access. Registration and usage terms may apply.

records.title: World Values Survey
records.scope: Cross-national values and beliefs. Repeated cross-sections are not respondent-level longitudinal panels.
records.access: Official WVS documentation. Registration and non-redistribution terms may apply.

records.title: MIDUS · Midlife in the United States
records.scope: Longitudinal US study with religion/spirituality, psychological wellbeing, purpose, mental illness and health domains. US context limits transfer.
records.access: Official MIDUS documentation and public data resources; study-specific terms remain authoritative.
